adaptation: The two pinned addr_kernel scalar lambdas and beta==0 dispatch are retained. Uniform TensorIterator dispatch is distributed over its independent elements; the arithmetic order is unchanged. Float overloads map to equivalent C functions; arrays remain contiguous and dynamic length. The cuDNN graph is mechanically emitted from imported reference IR, with separately tested opcode semantics, not imported cuDNN source.

specs.name: aten_addr_elementwise_f32
assumptions: positive n <= INT_MAX; contiguous FP32 arrays
output disjoint from inputs; errno and floating exception flags not observed
